title: Artificial Intelligence for Small Business
description: Small businesses are being told they need artificial intelligence, usually by people selling it. This book cuts through the fog. Artificial Intelligence for Small Business explains where AI can genuinely help with marketing, admin, customer service, planning, research and everyday operations, without pretending it will run the whole business while you drink tea and admire your own efficiency. Written in plain English for owners, freelancers, local services, consultants, creators and small teams, it focuses on practical workflows rather than technical theory. You will learn how to spot useful tasks, avoid gimmicks, improve customer communication, speed up routine work and keep control of quality. The book also covers privacy, brand voice, accuracy, cost, staff confidence and the awkward truth that some jobs still need a human being with context. It is calm, practical and sceptical in the right places. Useful AI for small business is not about chasing every shiny tool. It is about choosing a few sensible workflows and using them well.
short_description: A plain-English guide to using artificial intelligence in small business workflows, from marketing and admin to customer service, privacy and cost control.
author: Jonathan Harris
audience: Small business owners, sole traders, freelancers, consultants, indie authors, local service providers, creators and small teams who want practical AI use without technical waffle.
